LESSON: SAFETY IN THE HOME

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Home Management
Topic 2.2: Safety in the Home
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Safety in the Home, part of Home Management in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How can we ensure safety in the home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Safety in the Home in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Safety in the Home together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: the learners interact with technology as they search for information on the contents of the First Aid

kit.

● Critical thinking and Problem-solving: the learners evaluate and make decisions on First Aid items to improvise

using locally available materials.

Values:
● Integrity: the learner utilises resources prudently when improvising the First Aid kit using locally available

materials.

● Love: the learners portray a caring attitude when carrying out First Aid for various injuries at home.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Waste Management: the learner disposes of used First Aid materials appropriately.

● Road Safety: the learner is made aware of how to carry out First Aid for various injuries that occur at home and

even on the road using appropriate First Aid items.
